title: Crucial P310 500GB M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD $120.14 Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU
body:
Deal: Crucial P310 500GB M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD $120.14 Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU

[ddoraaaaa] that is a very long title without the capacity of the drive
[Dack Smith] No DRAM cache?
Well they don’t care anymore, all the RAM contracts are pre fixed until 2029 so prices will only increase.
[tonyjzx] crucial gives so little fucs they pulled out and yet the are stilling selling ssds
[ATangk] Probably older stock that they're drip feeding out to keep prices high and profits maximised.
[NSWbargains] Is it worth biting the bullet if I only need 256GB?
[bargaino] Plenty of used 256 are available from people upgrading.
[NSWbargains] And yours is likely the most useless comment in this thread.
[NSWbargains] All right, tech bro hoarder.
I thought this place is about bargain but apparently not.
[darkly] Also the Crucial P310 2280 PCIe Gen4 3D NAND NVMe M.2 Internal Solid State Drive, 1TB for $220.71
[freefall101] Can get P510 (Gen5) for $20 more - https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0DZ5ZK225 - which is actually a reasonable price (same price as April).
Worth it since it has way better endurance (220TBW vs 600TBW)
